comment: Package kit hints for Masterplan (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). Masterplan is open to everyone signed in and checks rights per project (access.js): lists come back filtered, so the kit compares them with the superadmin's; the reference lists below carry no project data. The CRM and Contracts are module packages too (linked packages of the kit, `packages`); on the upgrade source v1.19.0 all three are built in.

apiParams.projectId: SELECT id FROM mp_projects ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM mp_projects ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.dealId: SELECT deal_id FROM mp_units WHERE deal_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY node_id LIMIT 1

pageParams.projectId: SELECT id FROM mp_projects ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

openToUsersWhy.meta: statuses, types, stages, the person's own access (projects inside are filtered)
openToUsersWhy.users: people picker (names and avatars of active users, as elsewhere in the portal)

needsOtherScopesWhy: a deal's units: the CRM deal is checked with the CRM area too (crmLink.js dealForLink)
